reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِىِّ بْنِ أَسْباط قالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِىِّ بْنِ مُوسَى الرِّضا

reasons.claim: Al-Rida relays from his forefathers, then from Ali, who quotes the Prophet and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ آبائِهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِ‏ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَن رَسُولَ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters share the first level joined by «قالوا».
reasons.quote: وقتيبة، وابن، حجر قالوا حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر

reasons.claim: Anas speaks the saying inside the narrated visit, so he is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول

reasons.claim: A single «عن» chain ends at Malik b. al-Huwayrith, who tells his own account of the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أبي قلابة، عن مالك بن الحويرث، أتيت النبي

reasons.claim: The suspended chain opens at Abd Allah b. Salim and continues through al-Zubaydi to Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim.
reasons.quote: وقال عبد الله بن سالم عن الزبيدي، قال عبد الرحمن بن القاسم أخبرني القاسم

reasons.claim: Aisha speaks the report and is the last link.
reasons.quote: أن عائشة  رضى الله عنها  قالت

review.question: the Prophet speaking a one-sentence report with no transmitter

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter or speaker written before it.
reasons.quote: شَرُّ اَلْمَآكِلِ أَكْلُ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level; the verb split does not create separate routes.
reasons.quote: قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو معاوية

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Hudhayfa quoting the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن شقيق، عن حذيفة، قال قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters meet at Yahya b. al-Yaman via «قالوا».
reasons.quote: وأبو بكر بن خلاد قالوا حدثنا يحيى بن اليمان

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Ibn Abbas relating the Prophet's act.
reasons.quote: عن عطاء، عن ابن عباس، أن النبي

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters meet at Waki via «قالا».
reasons.quote: وعلي بن محمد، قالا حدثنا وكيع

reasons.claim: Abu Hurayra speaks inside Ikrima's narrated visit and is the last link.
reasons.quote: فقال أبو هريرة نهى رسول الله

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni relays through an unwritten chain to the Commander of the Faithful, who gives the ruling and is the last link.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

reasons.claim: The gap «بإسناده» is kept as one link; its kind changes no route.
reasons.quote: بِإِسْنَادِهِ

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters stand under Hamduwayh, and Ibrahim with an unnamed other stand under Ibn Abi Umayr.
reasons.quote: عن يعقوب بن يزيد و محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

reasons.claim: The co-transmitters all relate the Imam's words, so the Imam is the last link.
reasons.quote: إبراهيم بن عبد الحميد و غيره قالوا: قال أبو عبد الله

reasons.claim: The book title is not a link and the modern compiler heads no chain.
reasons.quote: رجال الكشي: حمدويه بن نصير

reasons.claim: Yunus narrates from his brother Yusuf, one link with the name alone.
reasons.quote: عَنْ يُوسُفَ أَخِيهِ

reasons.claim: Abu Abd Allah speaks inside the narrated encounter, so he is the last link (ruling 9); the sitter who only remarks is not a link.
reasons.quote: فَسَلْهُ أَ ذَهَبٌ هُوَ

reasons.claim: Yazid transmits from Sufyan and from Hammad, each line writing Amr and his father again, giving two routes.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، وحماد بن سلمة، عن عمرو بن يحيى

reasons.claim: Both routes end at Abu Said al-Khudri.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال

reasons.claim: Hisham narrates from his father from Aisha, who is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Aisha's words are the report.
reasons.quote: قالت هذا في اليتيمة

reasons.claim: Abu Sufyan tells of visiting Umm Habiba, who speaks and relays the Prophet's words, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: ثم قالت له توضأ يا ابن أختي

reasons.claim: Abu Salama received it from Abu Sufyan.
reasons.quote: أخبره عن أبي سفيان بن سعيد بن الأخنس بن شريق

reasons.claim: Qutayba and Ibn Rumh are co-transmitters from al-Layth; «قال ابن رمح» only gives his wording.
reasons.quote: قال ابن رمح أخبرنا الليث

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: أن أبا هريرة، أخبره

reasons.claim: Umar is the asker, and by ruling 3 the asker is a link before the one who answers; both readers dropped him.
reasons.quote: أن عمر بن الخطاب، سأل أبا واقد الليثي

reasons.claim: Abu Waqid answers and is the last link.
reasons.quote: فقال كان يقرأ فيهما

notes: Umar is the asker, a link under ruling 3.

review.uncertainty_note: Ubayd Allah reports the question with «أن», but ruling 3 makes the asker a link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs Yahya, Malik, Damra, Ubaydallah as the readers have it.
reasons.quote: قرأت على مالك عن ضمرة بن سعيد المازني، عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: Umar asks and Abu Waqid answers, so under ruling 3 the asker Umar is a link before Abu Waqid.
reasons.quote: أن عمر بن الخطاب، سأل أبا واقد الليثي

notes: the asker is a link (ruling 3)

second_review.uncertainty_note: Ubaydallah may tell the scene without hearing it from Umar, but ruling 3 makes the asker a link.

reasons.claim: Ismail b. Abi Ziyad is the only named link and «بإسناده» stands for his unwritten chain; the kind given to it changes no route.
reasons.quote: رَوَى إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ

reasons.claim: Abu Ayyub and al-Ala are co-transmitters from al-Hasan b. Mahbub to Muhammad b. Muslim.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْخَزَّازِ وَ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ

reasons.claim: The Imam heard by Muhammad b. Muslim is the last link.
reasons.quote: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع يَقُولُ

reasons.claim: The text is the compiler's own argument with no transmitter; the stored chain is words that are not names.
reasons.quote: وهذه أيضا طريقة معتمدة اعتمدها الشيوخ قديما

reasons.claim: «يعني ابن زكرياء» is a gloss, so the surface is Ismail alone.
reasons.quote: إسماعيل يعني ابن زكرياء

reasons.claim: Suhayl narrates from his unnamed sister, a relation link, to Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: عن سهيل، حدثتني

reasons.claim: The chain runs Abu al-Yaman, Shu'ayb, Abu al-Zinad, al-A'raj, Abu Hurayra, as both readers wrote.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو اليمان، قال أخبرنا شعيب، قال حدثنا أبو الزناد، أن عبد الرحمن بن هرمز الأعرج

reasons.claim: Abu Hurayra heard the Prophet, so he is the last link and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: سمع أبا هريرة

reasons.claim: The stored chain omits al-A'raj, who is written in the text.
reasons.quote: أبو الزناد

reasons.claim: Each name joined by «عن» is a link in order, and the unnamed group carries the chain to the Imam.
reasons.quote: عن عدة من أصحابنا يرفعونه إلى أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: The chain opens with the compiler's shaykh Muhammad b. al-Hasan.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن

reasons.claim: The chain is written after the story and names three links ending at the Imam.
reasons.quote: رَوَى ذَلِكَ مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The stored first name is words of the story, not a transmitter.
reasons.quote: و ذلك

reasons.claim: The links run in the text's order from al-Warraq to Jamil b. Salih and the Imam.
reasons.quote: عن إبراهيم بن مهزيار، عن أخيه علي، عن الحسين بن سعيد

reasons.claim: The Imam's forefathers are the last link as an unnamed relation, and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: عن آبائه (عليهم السلام)، قال: قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The compiler's father, al-Himyari, a marked gap, Ali b. Maymun and the Imam form the chain.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الصَّائِغِ

reasons.claim: The father is written only as «أبي», a bare relation.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

review.question: a saying introduced with no transmitter and no named speaker («في حديث آخر قال»)

reasons.claim: No transmitter or speaker is named before the saying.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ قَالَ

review.uncertainty_note: The unnamed speaker may be meant to come from an earlier report that the packet does not include.

reasons.claim: Abd Allah b. Ka'b heard Ka'b b. Malik, so both are links and Ka'b is last.
reasons.quote: أن عبد الله بن كعب، قال سمعت كعب بن مالك

reasons.claim: The stored chain leaves out Abd Allah b. Ka'b.
reasons.quote: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله

review.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying

reasons.claim: The route runs from the compiler's father to Imran al-Halabi through four named links, which is the reading whether or not the route statement is ruled a chain.
reasons.quote: عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه- عن سعد بن عبد اللّه

reasons.claim: The kunya after the last name is a remark, not a link.
reasons.quote: و كنيته أبو الفضل

reasons.claim: In the narrated encounter al-Samari speaks, so he is the last link after Ahmad b. Ibrahim (ruling 9).
reasons.quote: فقال الشيخ أبو الحسن علي بن محمد السمري

reasons.claim: The shaykhs present are not links.
reasons.quote: حضرت بغداد عند المشايخ

reasons.claim: The chain opens with an unnamed group then Ibn Babawayh.
reasons.quote: وأخبرني جماعة عن أبي جعفر

reasons.claim: The Imam is the only named source and the Prophet he quotes ends the chain.
reasons.quote: عن الصادق عليه السلام أنه قال

reasons.claim: The chain runs through seven named transmitters and ends with Abu al-Khalid, whose sworn words are the report.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن نجران أن أبا الخالد حدثه وحلف له عليه

reasons.claim: Al-Harawi asks al-Rida, who answers, so al-Rida is the last link after the four transmitters.
reasons.quote: قلت للرضا عليه السلام

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters share one level, marked by the plural verb.
reasons.quote: ومحمد بن أحمد القطواني قالوا

reasons.claim: An unnamed trusted companion is a gap link, and Amir al-Mu'minin, whose sermon is quoted, is the last link.
reasons.quote: سمعت من يوثق به من أصحاب أمير المؤمنين يقول: قال أمير المؤمنين

reasons.claim: Ibn Rafi' and 'Abd are co-transmitters from 'Abd al-Razzaq; the repeated mention only records their verbs.
reasons.quote: قال ابن رافع حدثنا وقال عبد، أخبرنا عبد الرزاق

reasons.claim: Abu Hurayra quoting the Prophet is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي هريرة، قال قال النبي

reasons.claim: The tahwil gives a first branch ending at Shu'ba and a second with two co-transmitters, meeting at Shu'ba; the tail is shared.
reasons.quote: عن شعبة، ح وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، وابن بشار قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن منصور

reasons.claim: Jabir narrates from Abu Ja'far, who speaks; the opening words about the mosque are not a name.
reasons.quote: رَوَى جَابِرٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

review.question: the author of a cited book

reasons.claim: The compiler's shaykh relays, in his book, from Abu al-Hasan, who speaks; the book title is no link, and the structure holds whichever way the cited-book question is ruled.
reasons.quote: فِي كِتَابِ الْجَامِعِ يَرْوِي عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ

review.uncertainty_note: The words «يروي عن» may hide a gap between the shaykh and the Imam, which the text does not name.

reasons.claim: The chain is the five names after «حديث», ending with Abu 'Abd Allah who speaks; «وأما حديث» is not part of a name.
reasons.quote: وَ أَمَّا حَدِيثُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ

reasons.claim: A kunya followed by a name is one man.
reasons.quote: أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ شَدَّادٍ اَلْأَزْدِيِّ

reasons.claim: Ata' heard from an unnamed man who heard the Companion, so an unnamed link stands between them.
reasons.quote: حدثني من، سمع عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

reasons.claim: «وهو القناد» is a gloss on Abu Isma'il, not a link.
reasons.quote: أبو إسماعيل، - وهو القناد -

reasons.claim: 'Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada relates from his father, who relates from the Prophet; the father is the last link.
reasons.quote: عبد الله بن أبي قتادة، حدثه عن أبيه، عن النبي

reasons.claim: Al-Barmaki relates from al-Nakha'i, who is the asker and a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلْبَرْمَكِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلنَّخَعِيُّ

reasons.claim: The Imam who is asked and answers is the last link, named in the words after the chain.
reasons.quote: قُلْتُ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ

reasons.claim: The bracketed title is no part of the chain, so the stored chain's first name is defective.
reasons.quote: زيارة جامعة لجميع الأئمة - روى محمد بن إسماعيل البرمكي

reasons.claim: The chain is written in full: Yahya read to Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir; «بهذا الحديث» refers to the wording, not the chain.
reasons.quote: قرأت على مالك عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر،

reasons.claim: Zuhayr relates from Salim, who heard al-Hasan, who heard Jabir; the stored chain stops early.
reasons.quote: عن زهير، قال قال سالم سمعت الحسن، يقول حدثنا جابر بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: Zayd from his unnamed father, from Umar, who tells the scene and is the last link.
reasons.quote: زيد بن أسلم، عن أبيه، عن عمر بن الخطاب

reasons.claim: Abd Allah b. Ka'b is a link who heard Ka'b; the stored chain omits him.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت كعب بن مالك

reasons.claim: The clause about leading Ka'b is a description, not a link.
reasons.quote: وكان قائد كعب من بنيه حين عمي

reasons.claim: The single route runs to the second bare «عبد الله», who speaks the report.
reasons.quote: عن سالم، عن عبد الله، قال

reasons.claim: Yahya read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Ata', from Abu Ayyub; the stored chain holds only Yahya.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن ابن شهاب، عن عطاء بن يزيد، الليثي عن أبي أيوب الأنصاري

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters share one level by «قالا».
reasons.quote: قالا أخبرنا ابن أبي فديك

reasons.claim: The gloss between dashes is not a link, and Abd al-Malik, missing from the stored chain, is.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الملك بن زيد، - نسبه جعفر

reasons.claim: The three heads share one level and meet at Waki'; only the verb differs.
reasons.quote: قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا وكيع

reasons.claim: The chain continues to Ibn Abbas, the last link.
reasons.quote: سمعت مجاهدا، يحدث عن طاوس، عن ابن عباس

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni is the one named link, and «بإسناده» stands after him for his unwritten chain to the Prophet, who is not a link.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ

review.uncertainty_note: The links after al-Sakuni are not written here, so the route can only be recorded with a back reference.

reasons.claim: A single chain runs from Yahya b. Khalaf to Abu Qatada, the gloss on Muhammad being no link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد، - يعني ابن إسحاق - عن سعيد بن أبي سعيد المقبري

reasons.claim: Musa b. Bakr is joined to Abd al-Karim as a second shaykh of al-Bazanti, so the second route also starts from al-Bazanti.
reasons.quote: عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ

reasons.claim: The addition attributed to Abd al-Karim confirms he and Musa are parallel transmitters under one head.
reasons.quote: وَ زَادَ عَبْدُ اَلْكَرِيمِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ

levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: Al-Bazanti heads both routes: «و موسى بن بكر» is coordinated with Abd al-Karim after «عن».

review.uncertainty_note: The «و» could in principle start a new route from the compiler, but the coordination and the «زاد عبد الكريم» remark favour al-Bazanti as common head.

reasons.claim: Ahmad and Musaddad are co-transmitters from Bishr, and the dashes hold glosses only.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن حنبل، ومسدد، قالا حدثنا بشر

reasons.claim: The asker is a link (ruling 3), so Aban stands between Abu al-Faraj and the Imam he asked.
reasons.quote: سأل أبان أبا عبد الله

reasons.claim: Safwan and al-Qasim are co-transmitters from al-Kahili.
reasons.quote: عن صفوان، والقاسم، عن الكاهلي

notes: «سأل أبان أبا عبد الله»: the asker Aban is a link (ruling 3), then the Imam who answers.

reasons.claim: The chain with Safwan and al-Qasim as co-transmitters is read correctly to Abu al-Faraj.
reasons.quote: عن صفوان، والقاسم، عن الكاهلي، عن أبي الفرج

reasons.claim: Aban asks the Imam, so under ruling 3 Aban is a link between Abu al-Faraj and the Imam, who answers.
reasons.quote: سأل أبان أبا عبد الله عليه السلام

notes: the asker Aban is a link (ruling 3)

reasons.claim: Abu Salama heard Aisha, whose words are the report, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع عائشة

reasons.claim: The report names no transmitter, only another report.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ

reasons.claim: Ishaq read to Abu Qurra, who is the next link, and the chain ends at Jabir, whose account is the report.
reasons.quote: قرأت على أبي قرة موسى بن طارق عن ابن جريج

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters take from al-Layth, and Urwa and Amra both relate from Aisha.
reasons.quote: عن عروة، وعمرة بنت عبد الرحمن، أن عائشة

reasons.claim: Al-Hasan b. Mahbub transmits from two co-transmitters who meet at Tirbal, and the chain ends at Abu Jafar.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ وَ خَطَّابٍ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْهَمْدَانِيِّ عَنْ طِرْبَالٍ

reasons.claim: An unnamed group carries the chain up to Amir al-Muminin, who quotes the Prophet and is the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا جماعة من أصحابنا رفعوه إلى أميـر المؤمنيـن

reasons.claim: Qatada and Ayyub are co-transmitters from Sa'id, both handing on to Salih Abi al-Khalil.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، وأيوب، عن صالح أبي الخليل

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Umm al-Fadl, who relays the Prophet's answer.
reasons.quote: عن أم الفضل، أن نبي الله

reasons.claim: Qatada's alternative wording at the end is a wording remark and adds no route.
reasons.quote: وقال قتادة

reasons.claim: The chain runs through al-Qasim b. Muslim to his brother Abd al-Aziz b. Muslim.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَني القاسِم بْنِ مُسْلِم، عَن أَخِيهِ عَبْد العَزِيز بْنِ مُسْلِم

reasons.claim: In the narrated encounter the Imam speaks to Abd al-Aziz, so he is the last link (ruling 9).

reasons.quote: حدثنا يزيد بن إبراهيم، عن محمد، عن أم عطية

reasons.claim: The chain after the text writes its own transmitters and carries this saying, so under working rule 11 it is a second route.
reasons.quote: وقال عبد الله بن رجاء حدثنا عمران، حدثنا محمد بن سيرين، حدثتنا أم عطية

review.uncertainty_note: If rule 11 were not adopted, the second route would be a remark.

reasons.claim: Ibn Bashshar and the unnamed others are co-transmitters from Hisham, and the gloss is left out.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، وغير، واحد، - المعنى واحد واللفظ لابن بشار قالوا

reasons.claim: Abu Rafi' relays Abu Hurayra's hadith from the Prophet, so Abu Hurayra is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي رافع عن حديث أبي هريرة عن النبي

review.uncertainty_note: «عن حديث أبي هريرة» is an unusual wording, but it still places Abu Hurayra after Abu Rafi'.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters head the chain and both take from al-Layth.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يزيد بن خالد الهمداني، وقتيبة بن سعيد الثقفي، أن الليث، حدثهم

reasons.claim: Al-Layth takes from Abu al-Zubayr, who takes from Jabir, the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، أن النبي

reasons.claim: The stored chain drops al-Layth, so it is defective.
reasons.quote: قتيبة بن سعيد الثقفي

reasons.claim: Nasr takes from two co-transmitters, al-Walid and Mubashshir.
reasons.quote: حدثنا الوليد، ومبشر،

reasons.claim: Both take from Abu Amr, written once for Mubashshir and again for al-Walid; it is one link.
reasons.quote: قال - يعني الوليد - حدثنا أبو عمرو

reasons.claim: Qatada takes from two Companions, who share the last level.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سعيد الخدري، وأنس بن مالك، عن رسول الله

reasons.claim: The chain runs Muhammad, Hajjaj, Jarir, al-Hasan, Jundab.
reasons.quote: حدثني محمد، قال حدثني حجاج، حدثنا جرير، عن الحسن، حدثنا جندب بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: The words about not forgetting and not fearing a lie are a remark, not links.
reasons.quote: وما نخشى أن يكون جندب كذب

reasons.claim: The written chain is Yahya, Ja'far, al-Ja'd.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، حدثنا جعفر بن سليمان، عن الجعد أبي عثمان

reasons.claim: The rest of the chain is taken from an earlier isnad that the packet does not supply, so it cannot be written as inherited links.
reasons.quote: في هذا الإسناد بمعنى حديث عبد الوارث

review.uncertainty_note: The links after al-Ja'd come from a previous report that is not in the packet.

reasons.claim: The chain runs Abu Bakr, Waki', Hisham, Qatada, Anas.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، عن هشام، عن قتادة، عن أنس

reasons.claim: The closing words are a wording remark with no route.
reasons.quote: ثم ذكر نحو حديثهما

reasons.claim: The Imam speaks with no transmitter written, so he is the single link after the compiler.
reasons.quote: وَ قَالَ اَلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: The chain runs Hudhayfa, Mu'adh, Abu Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: وفي رواية حذيفة بن منصور عن معاذ بن كثير

reasons.claim: The dashed words are a gloss on Mu'adh, not a second man.
reasons.quote: - ويقال له: معاذ بن مسلم الهراء -

reasons.claim: The Imam is asked nothing but answers as the source and ends the chain.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: The chain runs al-Hasan, Husayn, Ibn Awn, al-Qasim, Umm al-Mu'minin; the dashed words are a gloss.
reasons.quote: حسين، - يعني ابن حسن - عن ابن عون، عن القاسم، عن أم المؤمنين

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops before the last link, who speaks the saying.
reasons.quote: قالت أنا فتلت

reasons.claim: The chain runs through six names to Aisha.
reasons.quote: حدثني مقاتل بن بشير العجلي، عن شريح بن هانئ، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Shurayh asks and Aisha answers, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال سألتها عن صلاة

reasons.claim: The report is a saying alone with no transmitter or speaker before it.
reasons.quote: هِبَةُ اَلرَّجُلِ لِزَوْجَتِهِ

review.question: a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker: whether the unnamed shaykh who speaks is written as an unnamed last link

reasons.claim: The chain runs by «عن» from Musa to Alqama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا موسى، عن أبي عوانة، عن مغيرة، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة

reasons.claim: Alqama tells of an encounter with a shaykh, who speaks inside the story.
reasons.quote: فرأيت شيخا مقبلا

reasons.claim: The saying the report relays is the shaykh's own words about how the Prophet taught him, so under ruling 9 the one who spoke is the last link after Alqama; he is unnamed.
reasons.quote: قال أقرأنيها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فاه إلى في

notes: the shaykh speaks in the story and relays the Prophet's recitation: last link under ruling 9, unnamed

review.uncertainty_note: If the unnamed speaker is not to be stored, the readers' chain ending at Alqama would stand.

second_review.question: a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker

reasons.claim: The chain to Alqama is read correctly.
reasons.quote: عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، دخلت الشأم

reasons.claim: Alqama tells an encounter in which an unnamed shaykh speaks and relays the Prophet's reading, so under ruling 9 the shaykh is the last link, an unnamed one.
reasons.quote: قال أقرأنيها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: The shaykh is written only as an old man approaching.
reasons.quote: فرأيت شيخا مقبلا

notes: narrated encounter (ruling 9): the unnamed shaykh speaks

second_review.uncertainty_note: The speaker is unnamed, which touches the unruled first-person narrative question.

reasons.claim: The chain runs to Ibn Abbad and his father, named in apposition as one link.
reasons.quote: حدثني ابن عباد، عن أبيه، عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير

reasons.claim: The father then says he heard from his foster father, a transmitter named only by relation.
reasons.quote: حدثني أبي الذي، أرضعني

reasons.claim: The foster father, who was at Mu'ta, speaks the saying, so he is the last link and the readers stop one link short.
reasons.quote: قال والله لكأني أنظر إلى جعفر

levels.surface: عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: the foster father who saw Mu'ta transmits to Abbad with «حدثني» and speaks the saying: last link

review.uncertainty_note: The foster father is named only by relation, so how his surface is written may differ.

reasons.claim: The chain to Abbad b. Abdallah b. al-Zubayr is read correctly, the apposition being one link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير

reasons.claim: Abbad says his foster father told him, and that foster father, present at Muta, speaks the saying, so he is the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثني أبي الذي، أرضعني

reasons.claim: The saying is the eyewitness's own words.
reasons.quote: قال والله لكأني أنظر إلى جعفر

levels.surface: عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير

notes: «حدثني أبي الذي أرضعني» is a further link, the foster father

second_review.uncertainty_note: The dashes make the clause look like an aside, but «حدثني» marks transmission.

reasons.claim: «ح» splits a first branch to Hushaym from a second with two co-transmitters, and the tail is written once.
reasons.quote: حدثنا  شريك بن عبد الله، وهشيم بن بشير، عن يعلى بن عطاء، عن عمرو بن الشريد، عن أبيه

reasons.claim: The chain runs through Mansur and his mother to Aisha, with the gloss between dashes left out.
reasons.quote: عن منصور، - وهو ابن صفية - عن أمه، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Aisha reports her own story, so she is the last link after al-Qasim.
reasons.quote: عن القاسم بن محمد، عن عائشة أم المؤمنين

reasons.claim: Two branches meet at Ibn Jurayj and share the tail to Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن جريج، أخبرني زياد، أن ثابتا، مولى عبد الرحمن بن زيد أخبره أنه، سمع أبا هريرة

reasons.claim: The chain is a single «عن» series ending at Abu Dharr, who tells his own encounter with the Prophet.
reasons.quote: في حديثه عن أبي معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن المعرور بن سويد، عن أبي ذر

reasons.claim: Nafi' reports Ibn Umar's practice, which is only told, so Nafi' is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن نافع، قال كان ابن عمر يصلي

reasons.claim: The mention from Abu Hurayra is a different saying the compiler marks weak, not a route of this one.
reasons.quote: ويذكر عن أبي هريرة رفعه

reasons.claim: The chain runs through the relation «أبيه» to Safiyya, who tells her own visit.
reasons.quote: أخبرني علي بن الحسين، عن صفية بنت حيى

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters all heard Zayd b. Wahb, one level of alternatives.
reasons.quote: والأعمش، كلهم سمعوا زيد بن وهب، عن أبي ذر

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters, the last an unnamed group, stand at the first level and all say «قالوا» from Abu Usama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كريب، وعبد بن حميد، وغير، واحد، قالوا أخبرنا أبو أسامة

reasons.claim: The chain runs on through al-Hasan and Abu Sabra to Farwa, who tells of coming to the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو سبرة النخعي، عن فروة بن مسيك المرادي، قال أتيت النبي

reasons.claim: The Ibn Abbas line has no transmitters of its own and is a remark, not a route.
reasons.quote: وروي هذا عن ابن عباس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: The report relays only Hafs's habit of how he introduced Ja'far, so the words relayed are Hafs's own and he is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن حفص بن غياث، أنه كان إذا حدثنا عن جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام)، قال: حدثني خير الجعافر

reasons.claim: Ja'far is only named and described inside the account of Hafs's habit; he says nothing in this report, so he is not a link (ruling 4).
reasons.quote: حدثني خير الجعافر جعفر بن محمد

reasons.claim: The five transmitters before Hafs are written in order, each with «حدثنا».
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن أحمد السناني، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: The report is Hafs's habit of introducing Ja'far; Ja'far speaks no words here and is not a link.

review.uncertainty_note: One could read the report as Hafs relaying from Ja'far, but no saying of Ja'far is given.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from al-Sinani through Sulayman to Hafs in a single line.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سليمان بن داود المنقري، عن حفص بن غياث

reasons.claim: What the report relays is Hafs's own habit, told about him; Ja'far is only the one Hafs used to narrate from, and he says nothing here.
reasons.quote: أنه كان إذا حدثنا عن جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام)، قال: حدثني خير الجعافر

reasons.claim: The words relayed are Hafs's, so Hafs is the last link and Ja'far, only described, is no link (rulings 2 and 4); both readers wrongly add him.
reasons.quote: قال: حدثني خير الجعافر جعفر بن محمد

levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: The report tells Hafs's practice of praising Ja'far when narrating from him; no saying of Ja'far is relayed, so the chain ends at Hafs.

second_review.uncertainty_note: One could read Hafs's formula as a statement about every report he heard from Ja'far, but no saying of Ja'far is carried here.

reasons.claim: One chain of four links, the second written only as «أبي».
reasons.quote: وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن حميد بن نافع

reasons.claim: «جميعا» joins the two reports carried, not routes, and «نحو حديث محمد بن جعفر» is a bare comparison remark.
reasons.quote: بالحديثين جميعا

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the saying alone.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ قَصَدَ

reasons.claim: One chain of five links ends at Jabir, whose words about Bilal are the report.
reasons.quote: عن سماك بن حرب، عن جابر بن سمرة، قال كان بلال

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters from Ibn Idris all pass on from al-Maqburi.
reasons.quote: عن عبيد الله، وابن، جريج وابن إسحاق ومالك بن أنس عن المقبري

reasons.claim: Ibn Umar is asked and answers, so he is the last link (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: قال قلت لابن عمر

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter.
reasons.quote: وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ

reasons.claim: Ibn Abi Umayr narrates from Aban and an unnamed other, both from the Imam, who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبَانٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the ruling alone.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ: «فِي اَلرَّجُلِ

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni narrates by his own unstated isnad to the Prophet, who ends the chain and is not a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: «بإسناده» is a gap rather than a pointer to an earlier report, but its kind changes no route.
reasons.quote: بإسناده

reasons.claim: Three taḥwīl branches open the chain, the third with two co-transmitters joined by «قالا».
reasons.quote: وحدثني زهير بن حرب، وابن المثنى، قالا حدثنا يحيى

reasons.claim: «كلهم عن» makes the rest a tail shared by every branch.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: «أبي» in the second branch is Ibn Numayr's unnamed father, a relation link.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا ابن نمير، حدثنا أبي

reasons.claim: No transmitter is written; the Imam is the one asked and answering, so he is the single link (ruling 2).
reasons.quote: وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ

review.uncertainty_note: A report with no transmitter at all may be treated differently by the owner.

reasons.claim: A single chain ends at Aisha, whose own words follow; the stored chain wrongly stops at Urwa.
reasons.quote: عن عروة، أن عائشة، رضى الله عنها أخبرته

reasons.claim: «هو ابن سعيد» is a gloss on Ishaq, not a link; the chain ends at Ibn Umar, who speaks.
reasons.quote: حدثنا إسحاق  هو ابن سعيد  عن سعيد، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters meet at Sufyan through «قالوا».
reasons.quote: ومحمود بن غيلان، قالوا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة

reasons.claim: Salim's unnamed father is the last link and speaks; those seen walking are not links.
reasons.quote: عن سالم، عن أبيه، قال رأيت النبي

reasons.claim: After Abu Ubayd the text writes only unnamed connected chains, an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبيد القاسم بن سلام بأسانيد متصلة إلى النبي

reasons.claim: The stored chain takes words of the explanation as names.
reasons.quote: المحاقلة

review.uncertainty_note: The explanatory matter after the saying could be read as Abu Ubayd's comment; it adds no link either way.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters meet at Zuhayr with «جميعا»; the dashed remark only states Ibn Yunus's wording and adds no route.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن زهير، - قال ابن يونس حدثنا زهير، -

reasons.claim: Abu al-Zubayr's later question runs along the same route and adds no link.
reasons.quote: قال أبو الزبير فسألت سعيدا

reasons.claim: One chain ends at Ibn Mughaffal, who speaks; «شك كهمس» is a note on the wording.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الله بن مغفل، أنه رأى رجلا يخذف فقال

reasons.claim: The father and «جماعة مشايخي» are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي

reasons.claim: Abu Abdillah narrates an event in which Amir al-Mu'minin speaks; under ruling 9 the speaker is the last link, which both readers omit.
reasons.quote: قَالَ مَرَّ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ (ع) بِكَرْبَلَاءَ

reasons.claim: The relayed words are Amir al-Mu'minin's.
reasons.quote: ثُمَّ قَالَ هَذَا مُنَاخُ رِكَابِهِمْ

levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن عبيد الله

notes: Amir al-Mu'minin speaks inside the Imam's narrated story: last link (ruling 9).

review.uncertainty_note: Ruling 9's example has the narrator present; here Abu Abdillah does not say he was present, so a second reading stopping at him is possible.

reasons.claim: One chain read to Malik ends at Ibn Umar; «واللفظ له» is a note, and the stored chain stops too early.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: The text writes one chain of four links from Ahmad b. Yunus to Jabir.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس، حدثنا زهير، حدثنا أبو الزبير، عن جابر

reasons.claim: The text ends at «ح» with no second branch written, so only one route can be read.
reasons.quote: عن جابر، ح

reasons.claim: The report is only a saying with no transmitter before it; the stored 'chain' is the saying's own words.
reasons.quote: اَلْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْعَائِدِ فِي قَيْئِهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs through five named transmitters to Muhammad b. al-Mu'alla.
reasons.quote: حدثني موسى بن جعفر البغدادي، عن محمد بن المعلي

reasons.claim: «عمن أخبره» is a gap and is rightly an unnamed link, separate from the name before it.
reasons.quote: عن محمد بن المعلي، عمن أخبره، عن أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: The Imam stands inside the chain after «عن» and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: «غير مرة» is a note on Sufyan's narrating, not a name, so the stored «سفيان غير» is defective.

reasons.claim: The chain continues to Umar, whose words the report relays.

reasons.claim: The first branch reaches Ibn Ajlan before «ح».
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد الله بن رجاء المكي، عن ابن عجلان، ح

reasons.claim: The second branch has two co-transmitters from Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba, meeting at Muhammad b. Ajlan.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، وأبو خالد الأحمر عن محمد بن عجلان

reasons.claim: Abu Salama tells of Aisha speaking, so she is the last link (narrated encounter), which the stored chain omits.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سلمة، قال رأت عائشة عبد الرحمن وهو يتوضأ فقالت

reasons.claim: Amr b. Talha is a link between Sulayman and Asbat; the stored chain drops him.
reasons.quote: أن عمرو بن طلحة، حدثهم قال حدثنا أسباط

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Ibn Abbas; the persons in the story are not links.
reasons.quote: عن سماك، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، في قصة

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters stand at the first level, giving four routes.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ أَخِي وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ

reasons.claim: «أبيه سدير» is one link, Sadir, after Hanan.
reasons.quote: عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَدِيرٍ

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Anas, who quotes the Prophet.

reasons.claim: «ح» opens a second branch from Muhammad b. Rumh, both meeting at al-Layth.

reasons.claim: Two Companions are co-transmitters at the last level, so the stored chain's lack of a Qutayba-to-Zayd route is a defect.
reasons.quote: عن أبي هريرة، وزيد بن خالد، الجهني أنهما قالا

reasons.claim: The passive «قد روي» names no transmitter, so there is no isnad; the stored 'chain' is words of the saying.
reasons.quote: وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ

reasons.claim: The chain runs Musaddad, Yahya, Hisham, Hafsa to Umm Atiyya, who relays the Prophet's words; both readers write exactly this.
reasons.quote: قال حدثتنا حفصة، عن أم عطية

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops at Hisham and omits the two last links the text writes.
reasons.quote: هشام بن حسان

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at one level are joined by «جميعا» at Ahmad, as both readers write.
reasons.quote: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَحْمَدَ

reasons.claim: «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter beside Ali b. al-Hakam.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ وَ غَيْرِهِ

reasons.claim: Ali relays the Prophet's words and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ (ع) قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The father and a group of shaykhs are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله) وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) قَالَ

reasons.claim: Hisham asks Ibrahim and Ibrahim answers, so Ibrahim is the last link (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: قال سألت إبراهيم عن العصير، قال اشربه

reasons.claim: Amr b. Sulaym is a link between Abu Bakr b. al-Munkadir and Abd al-Rahman; the stored chain drops him.
reasons.quote: أن عمرو بن سليم، أخبره عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد

reasons.claim: The bare relation «أبيه» relays the Prophet's words and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن رسول الله

reasons.claim: The report is an explanatory sentence with no transmitter, and the stored chain holds that sentence as a name.
reasons.quote: وَ سُمِّيَ اَلْبَيْتُ اَلْعَتِيقَ

reasons.claim: «رفعه إلى» marks an unnamed gap before the Imam, who is the last link.
reasons.quote: الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ الْمُخْتَارِ رَفَعَهُ إِلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ ع قَالَ

reasons.claim: Abu Ja'far relays the words of Ali, so Ali is the last link; the readers differ only in his kind, which changes no route.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ ع قَالَ قَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops at Abu Ja'far and omits Ali.
reasons.quote: أبی جعفر ع
